name: Mpox
summary: Clade Ib mpox has spread locally in Spain, Thailand and the Americas; no newer global figures found by 8 Nov
state: WHO's report of 26 June described clade Ib community transmission in Spain and Thailand, and PAHO counted 77 clade Ib cases in nine countries of the Americas to 31 July, including locally acquired cases in the US and Canada in July. Searches on 8 Nov found no newer global count and no report of a mpox emergency of international concern in force; WHO's June report called it a graded emergency under standing recommendations.
for_you: Most risk is through close skin-to-skin contact, including sex. UKHSA, NHS and WHO publish guidance, including on vaccination for people at higher risk.
rubric_hit: Watch: clade I spreading outside Africa (community transmission in Spain and Thailand; local US and Canadian cases, July)

sources.title: WHO — Multi-country outbreak of mpox, situation report 67

why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
drivers: Case growth, vaccine access, travel-linked spread.

rubric.alert: PHEIC in effect with accelerating growth.
rubric.watch: Clade I spreading outside Africa or a regional surge.
